 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Bhaskar Shankar, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Damodar Prasad Tiwary, App
 ===================================

===================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE MADHURESH PRASAD  ORAL ORDER 2 19-08-2023 1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 1861c of 2019 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 498A/34, 323, and 504 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has lodged a Matrimonial Divorce Case No. 185 of 2019, prior to lodging of the instant complaint petition alleging offences against the petitioner under section 498A and other provisions of the IPC.

4. Issue notice to opposite party no. 2 through both Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.40263 of 2023(2) dt.19-08-2023 modes i.e., under registered cover with A/D as well as under ordinary process, for which requisites etc. must be filed within one week, failing which the application shall stand rejected without further reference to a Bench.
Ritesh Kumar Sharma @ Hitesh Kumar ... vs The State Of Bihar on 19 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95492585/
1

5 . Let the matter be listed on 25.09.2023, or after service of notice/appearance of opposite party no.
2, whichever is earlier.
6. In the meantime, the petitioner shall not be arrested.

(Madhuresh Prasad, J) SUMIT/-
